description: Current and historical officers of a company as published in the BORME: administrators, attorneys (apoderados), auditors and similar roles with the date each was first seen. Documentary mentions only: no DNI, no contact data, and a mention does not prove the person still holds the role today. At most 500 mentions.

slug.description: Company slug, e.g. "telefonica-de-espana-sa". Get it from borme_search_companies (field `slug`).

name: borme_get_company_officers
